Finding a home in the Middle East has never been easier than with Property Finder. Whether you're buying or renting, you want a villa or a flat, we have it all.

Property Finder searches properties throughout the UAE, Bahrain, Qatar, Egypt, and Saudi Arabia and includes English and Arabic support. With homes and real estate, including apartments, penthouses, townhouses, and more, as well as plots of land and even offices, we'll help you find exactly what you're looking for. And when you do, Property Finder puts you in contact with the agent via phone, SMS, email, or WhatsApp.

Don't see what you're looking for? No problem! Take the stress out of searching by letting Property Finder do it for you. Saved searches remember your requirements and will notify you when a property that matches them becomes available for sale — we'll make sure you never miss that perfect property again.

Property Finder is full of features that are designed to take the hassle out of finding a property — whether that's a new house or somewhere to start a business. Some of those features include:

• Filters that make it easier to weed out the properties that don't meet your needs while highlighting those that do. Filters include the number of bedrooms, price, location, and much more.
• Saved searches that take criteria from your filtered searches and save them for future use — and we'll even send you a notification when a property matching your needs is listed.
• Digital tours mean you don't need to leave your home to find a new one. If an agent has provided a digital tour, we'll show it to you in Property Finder.
• Price trends and building reviews ensure you have the information you need before committing to a property. We'll show you how a home or office compares to the rest of the market while telling you how other residents feel about the building.
• Floor plans & 360-degree views give you a full picture of the property you're considering.
• Quick and easy ways to get the ball rolling. See a property you like? Get in touch with the agent directly via phone, SMS, WhatsApp, or email without hunting for their contact details online.

And that's just the start! You can learn more about Property Finder at https://www.propertyfinder.ae/ and download the app for free. You've never been closer to the property of your dreams!

Follow us on Facebook (https://www.fb.com/propertyfinderuae), Twitter (https://twitter.com/propertyfinder), Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/propertyfinder) or drop us a line over at apps@propertyfinder.ae and tell us what you think about our app.
